newsitem.title: GERMANY: Krupp shares top gainers pre-bourse.
newsitem.headline: Krupp shares top gainers pre-bourse.

text.p: Shares in German steelmaker Friedrich Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp were top gainers in early German electronic share trade on Monday after reports it planned to merge with fellow steel giant Thyssen AG.
The share was up 9.10 marks, or 2.84 percent, at 330 marks pre-bourse, while the overall market was down 52.55 points, or 1.21 percent, at 4,289.76 points.
The Spiegel news magazine reported that the two groups were stepping up merger talks, having agreed earlier this year to merge their flat steel businesses.
